messages.text:
Sarah:

1.  I just received my Thor B2 miner, and it has the same connector and a similar power supply. I plugged that power supply into the NerdOctaxe, and it started up. I’ll attach a photo of the miner running.
2.  Metering across the power supply connector on the miner board gave me falling ohm values. For instance, starting at 35k ohms and falling to 24k ohms before I removed the leads.
3.  I’ll attach a photo of the  board by the power connector.

Thanks.
Shawn U.

Sent from my iPhone
Handed to the team · Diagnostics are back. The replacement PSU needs JD's sign-off and someone to shi

Note to the team: I've sent your results to the team so they can approve the replacement power supply. It's flagged for JD, who handles the hardware.
